rows.explanation: Motion is free fall with quadratic air drag: q'' = -g + k*|v|v with g≈9.81 and k≈-0.35 (drag per unit mass, 1/length). Replacing unsigned v**2 with signed abs(v)*v drops held NRMSE from 0.135 to ~1e-9 and BIC from -344 to -788; q and v coefficients fit to ~1e-7 (zero) so dropped for parsimony.

Free fall with quadratic air drag: q'' = -g + k*|v|v with g=9.81 and k=-0.35 /m. Replacing unsigned v**2 with abs(v)*v drops held NRMSE from 0.135 to ~1e-9 and BIC from -344 to -788; q and v coefficients fit to ~1e-7 (zero) so sparser 2-term model wins. Residuals ~1e-9/1e-10 show only numerical noise.

Model q'' = -9.81 + c*abs(v)*v with c≈-0.35 is gravity plus quadratic air drag opposing motion. q and v coefficients fit to ~0, showing no spring or viscous force. Held NRMSE improves ~100% over baseline and BIC improves -344 to -757; residuals are ~1e-9 with no structure vs t or v.

Projectile under gravity with quadratic air drag: q'' = -g - (cd/m)|v|v. The unsigned v**2 baseline cannot oppose motion in both directions; replacing it with abs(v)*v drops held NRMSE from 0.135 to ~1e-9 and q,v coefficients fit to ~1e-7 (zero). The 2-term [1, abs(v)*v] model further improves BIC (-788) with no residual structure above 1e-9 numerical noise.

Projectile under gravity with quadratic air drag: q'' = -g + k*|v|v. Coefficient of 1 is gravity (-9.81), of abs(v)*v is drag per unit mass (~-0.35 1/m). Dropped baseline's unsigned v**2 (unphysical sign), and q,v terms (fit ~1e-7, zero). Residuals ~1e-9 (noise), held-out NRMSE ~1e-9 and BIC -788 vastly beat baseline.

Quadratic drag with shared coefficient: x''=-k|v|vx, y''=-g-k|v|vy. Fitted k=0.06 on both axes, g=9.81. Residuals ~1e-8 unstructured, held NRMSE improves 99.998% over baseline and BIC -938.7 vs -484.3.

Quadratic drag model: x''=c|v|vx, y''=-g+c|v|vy with c≈-0.06 on both axes and g≈9.81. Held NRMSE improves ~100% over baseline, BIC much lower, residuals ~1e-8 with no structure, coefficients agree in sign/magnitude as required.

Quadratic drag model: x'' = -k|v|vx, y'' = -g -k|v|vy with k~0.06 /m on both axes and g~9.81. Residuals ~1e-8 (noise only), held NRMSE improves 99.998% over baseline, BIC -938 vs -484. Same negative coefficient both axes confirms isotropic quadratic drag.

Quadratic speed-coupled drag with gravity on y only. x'': -k|v|vx, y'': -g -k|v|vy with common k≈0.06 (1/length) fitted identically on both axes (-0.06000 each) and g≈9.81. Residuals ~1e-8 (noise), held NRMSE improves 99.998% over baseline with much lower BIC, confirming drag coupled through total speed vs unsigned vx**2 terms.
Isotropic quadratic drag + gravity: x''=-k|v|vx, y''=-g-k|v|vy with shared k~0.06, g~9.81. Residuals ~1e-8 unstructured, held NRMSE improved 99.99% over baseline, BIC -938.7 vs -484.3.
